plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted (1) an instrument that checks the category against the requester's rule, since no instrument covers C3; (2) a check on the live tables directly, since summary of the change and same set read only the staged set; (3) a per-item check that every account read by the worker belongs to the approved list (scope of a call), which at 10 per named line for 100 reads costs 1000 and cannot be paid from the 50 allowance beyond about 5 lines; and (4) a per-item check that every confirmed sending call left an outbox row (trace of a call), which at 10 per line for 100 sends cannot be paid either. Both C5 and C10 are therefore not shown by the plan. The worker's reads and sends can still be sampled during the work if the allowance is used on a few named lines, but a sample does not show the whole clause. The plan also cannot cover the ordered-not-confirmed sending calls, which stay in doubt unless an instrument settles them.
